welcomeDescription: Connect vulnerability intel, asset context, and runtime records for a traceable security analysis.
liveSearchHelp: Enable model live search (xAI search_parameters; compatible gateways via extra_body). Ignored on auto-lite turns. Requires model/gateway support.
knowledgeSearchHelp: Allow Knowledge base retrieval for this turn. When off, knowledge tools are not attached. On auto-lite turns (no tool intent) this is ignored until a security-task message attaches tools.
cancelServerFailed: Stopped locally, but server cancel failed
toolsSkillsHelp: When on, connects MCP and Skills by intent: trivial turns skip tools and knowledge search; CVE/containment/playbook attach matching Skills and MCP namespaces; general security turns load all. Off is lite mode.
autoLeanHelp: No security-tool intent (e.g. CVE, containment, playbook, intranet assets). MCP/Skills, knowledge retrieval, and memory injection are skipped to save context. Mention those tasks to attach tools.
skillsAttachedHelp: Local Skills attached for this turn by intent.
skillsAllEnabled: General security intent; all enabled Local Skills are attached.
liveSearchNeedsTools: Turn on Tools/Skills first; lite and tools-off turns ignore Live Search.
knowledgeSearchNeedsTools: Turn on Tools/Skills first; lite and tools-off turns do not mount knowledge search.
liveSearchAutoLeanHint: Last turn was auto-lite; live search was not used. Your preference is kept and applies on the next tool-intent turn.
knowledgeSearchAutoLeanHint: Last turn was auto-lite; knowledge search was not mounted. Your preference is kept and applies on the next tool-intent turn.
